title: Bot Response Logging & Dashboard Display
notes: Add logging of LLM assistant responses (bot speech) to database and display in watch dashboard.

stories.title: Create assistant response logging processor
stories.description: Create a Pipecat processor that captures LLM assistant messages and logs them to the transcripts table with speaker_id='bot'.
acceptanceCriteria: Create AssistantResponseProcessor in src/assistant_response_logger.py
Processor captures assistant messages from LLMContext
Logs to transcripts table with ts, text, mode='assistant', speaker_id='bot'
Handles both text responses and tool call responses
Processor is inserted into pipeline after LLM service

stories.title: Wire assistant response logger into pipeline
stories.description: Insert the AssistantResponseProcessor into the Pipecat pipeline between LLM service and TTS.
acceptanceCriteria: Import assistant_response_logger in src/pipeline.py
Create processor instance with TranscriptStore
Insert after llm_service in stage list (before tts)
Verify processor is in the pipeline by checking stages
Pipeline still runs without errors

stories.title: Add 'Bot said' panel to watch dashboard
stories.description: Create a new panel in watch dashboard showing bot responses from transcripts table where speaker_id='bot'.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _bot_table() function in src/watch.py
Query last 8 transcripts WHERE speaker_id='bot' ORDER BY ts DESC
Display with timestamp and text columns
Show '(none yet)' placeholder when no bot responses
Style panel header with appropriate emoji (🗣️ or 🤖)

stories.title: Update watch dashboard layout for 3-column body
stories.description: Update _build_layout() to include the new 'Bot said' panel alongside 'You' and 'Heare did' panels.
acceptanceCriteria: Update _build_layout() to add 'bot' named layout
Body section splits into 3 columns: you, bot, did
Layout order preserved: header, activity, tools, body(3-col), log
All panels render without overlapping
Dashboard fits in standard terminal (80+ columns)

stories.title: Add tests for assistant response logging
stories.description: Add unit tests for the assistant response logger processor and watch dashboard bot panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Test AssistantResponseProcessor logs to transcripts table
Test _bot_table() renders bot responses correctly
Test _bot_table() handles empty db
Test _build_layout() includes 'bot' panel
All tests pass with 'make test'

stories.title: Verify end-to-end bot response logging
stories.description: Unit tests verify bot response logging and dashboard display. End-to-end verification requires running daemon with audio hardware.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify AssistantResponseProcessor logs bot responses
Tests verify _bot_table() displays bot transcripts
Tests verify 3-column layout (you, bot, did)
Tests verify _you_table() filters out bot responses
All 699 tests pass
